notes: 'all things' is split between the quantifier ('all') and the substantival article ('things'), following rule 17's τὰ πάντα; giving 'all things' whole to πάντα and only 'that' to the article remains defensible, the two words not being adjacent in the Greek.
s010 carries the supplied 'one'; putting it on ὑμῶν is the competing reading, and COL.4.12 reads the same construction the same way.
s015/s016 handle the bare-adverb article as COL.4.5 does: relativizer on the article, supplied verb on the adverb.
